meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后，它会检查 Azure 上的函数应用和 Web 应用的可靠性，包括区域冗余、存储冗余、健康检查和多区域故障转移。它会生成一张按功能分组的核查表，并在你同意后分步执行修复命令或更新 IaC 配置文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“assess reliability”“zone redundant”等关键词，或要求检查高可用时触发。仅覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service。

say.text: 帮我评估一下我的 Function App 的可靠性。
say.note: 它会扫描并给出可靠性核查表。

say.text: 检查我的 Web 应用是否启用了区域冗余。
say.note: 它会检查计算和存储，并报告状态。

say.text: 帮我启用区域冗余，并设置多区域故障转移。
say.note: 它先列修复计划，经你确认后执行。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses Azure Functions and App Service apps for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. It gives a feature-grouped checklist, then runs staged fixes (CLI or IaC) after user confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says keywords like 'assess reliability', 'zone redundant', or asks about high availability or multi-region failover. It covers only Azure Functions and App Service resources.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function App.
say_en.note: It will scan and produce a reliability checklist.

say_en.text: Check if my Web app is zone redundant.
say_en.note: It will check compute and storage and report status.

say_en.text: Enable zone redundancy and set up multi-region failover for my app.
say_en.note: It will list a fix plan and execute after your confirmation.
